facts.content: Patient reports a sudden left-sided headache with visual changes since the morning.
facts.source_text: CC: sudden L-sided HA w/ visual changes since this morning

facts.content: The headache onset was sudden and has lasted approximately 4 hours at the time of consultation.
facts.source_text: Onset sudden; ~4 h duration at consult; pain 6/10

facts.content: Patient experiences blurred vision with zigzag lines and cannot tolerate screens.
facts.source_text: Visual: blurred vision w/ zigzag lines; cannot tolerate screens

facts.content: The headache is associated with dizziness, nausea, and vomiting twice, with ongoing nausea.
facts.source_text: Assoc: dizziness; N/V—vomited x2; ongoing nausea

facts.content: The headache is worse with movement, and patient prefers to keep head still.
facts.source_text: Worse w/ movement; prefers head still

facts.content: Patient took paracetamol about 3 hours ago with no relief.
facts.source_text: Took paracetamol ~3 h ago; no relief

facts.content: This is the first headache of this type for the patient.
Patient denies limb weakness or gait disturbance.
facts.source_text: Denies limb weakness or gait disturbance

facts.content: Patient has a history of kidney stones.
Patient's mother has migraines and hypothyroidism.
Patient has no known drug allergies (NKDA).
Pregnancy is considered unlikely for the patient.
Patient is anxious about the possibility of a tumor or stroke and is considering the need for A&E.
facts.source_text: Pt anxious re tumor/stroke; queried need for A&E

facts.content: Probable migraine with visual aura noted, characterized by acute unilateral headache with blurred vision (zigzag), nausea, and vomiting; paracetamol was ineffective.
facts.source_text: Probable migraine w/ visual aura—acute unilateral HA w/ blurred vision (zigzag), N/V; no focal neuro sx by hx; paracetamol ineffective.

facts.content: Trial with ibuprofen, over-the-counter antiemetic, and a sugary carbonated drink like cola is planned.
facts.source_text: Trial ibuprofen + OTC antiemetic + sugary carbonated drink (e.g., cola)

facts.content: Counseling provided on possible relief in 30 to 40 minutes and that migraines may last 4 to 72 hours.
facts.source_text: Counsel: possible relief in 30–40 min; migraines may last 4–72 h

facts.content: Arrange same-day in-person review for full neurological exam unless symptoms resolve; instructed to attend unless improved and call to cancel if improved.
facts.source_text: Arrange same-day in-person review for full neuro exam; attend unless sx resolve; call to cancel if improved

facts.content: Patient is advised to contact the clinic for earlier review if no improvement after medications or if symptoms worsen before the appointment; call with any issues.
facts.source_text: If no improvement after meds or any worsening before appt, contact clinic for earlier review; call with any issues
